seo.title: About Us
seo.description: Learn about the history, mission, vision, and team of Armonizando Vidas A.B.P. An organization committed to real social impact.

hero.title: An organization with
hero.subtitle: We are Armonizando Vidas A.B.P., a civil association that believes in the transforming power of food, music, and community.

storyBand.title: We accompany processes,
storyBand.description: Our work starts with a concrete need, but grows when a family finds a network, a child discovers an artistic discipline, and a community feels supported again.
storyBand.imageAlt: Volunteers working together in a community day
items: We design programs that combine immediate aid with human follow-up.
Every partnership, donation, and volunteer hour is integrated into an impact strategy.
We measure results to grow responsibly and serve each community better.

mission.title: What we do today
mission.text: To transform vulnerable communities through food security programs and musical training, promoting human dignity, integral development, and hope as pillars of sustainable social change.

vision.title: What we build tomorrow
vision.text: To be the leading organization in community social transformation in northern Mexico, recognized for its measurable impact, its integral intervention model, and its capacity to replicate change in every community it touches.

milestones.title: Foundation
milestones.desc: Armonizando Vidas was born with a clear mission: transform lives from the ground up.

milestones.title: Official recognition
milestones.desc: We obtained registration as A.B.P. and recognition for our social impact.

milestones.title: National scale
milestones.desc: We surpassed 500 monthly families and 150 active musicians in 6 ensembles.

seo.title: Food Bank
seo.description: The Armonizando Vidas A.B.P. Food Bank rescues and distributes food for vulnerable families in Nuevo León. Donate or join as a volunteer.

hero.title: No family
hero.subtitle: We rescue food, fight waste, and reach hundreds of vulnerable families every month.

storyBand.title: We rescue food before it
storyBand.description: The Food Bank connects surplus food in good condition with families who need it. The key is to act fast, maintain quality, and distribute with dignity.
storyBand.imageAlt: People preparing food boxes for distribution
items: We receive donations of food, basic products, and transportation resources.
We organize sessions with volunteers to sort, weigh, and prepare food baskets.
We prioritize communities where a food basket can relieve immediate economic pressure.

steps.title: We rescue
steps.desc: We receive food donations from businesses, supermarkets, and individuals.

steps.title: We sort
steps.desc: Our team and volunteers sort, weigh, and package the food.

steps.title: We distribute
steps.desc: We deliver the food baskets directly to the communities served.

steps.title: We impact
steps.desc: More than 500 families receive fresh food every month thanks to this process.

cta.title: You can be part of this chain
cta.subtitle: Donate food, money, or your time. Every contribution feeds a real family.

seo.title: Donate — Food Bank
seo.description: Donate to the Armonizando Vidas Food Bank and help feed families in vulnerable situations.

hero.title: Your donation
hero.subtitle: Every peso goes directly to families.

storyBand.title: A food basket can change
storyBand.description: Donating to the Food Bank means supporting complementary purchases, fuel, packaging, delivery routes, and food that arrives with care.
items: The suggested amounts are designed around real needs and easy to understand.
Recurring donations allow us to plan routes and purchases with greater stability.
You can also donate non-perishable food or connect a partner company.

items.text: Provides basic food for one family for one week.
Covers a full monthly food basket for one family.
Feeds two families for the entire month.
Funds the operation of one distribution point for one week.

seo.title: Programs — Food Bank
seo.description: Learn about all the Food Bank programs at Armonizando Vidas: family baskets, food rescue, and corporate partnerships.

hero.title: Our
hero.subtitle: Multiple initiatives working together to guarantee food security.

storyBand.title: Each program responds to
storyBand.description: Not all families need the same thing. That's why we combine food baskets, fresh food rescue, corporate partnerships, and community donation points.
items: Family food baskets provide monthly stability to prioritized households.
Fresh food rescue reduces waste and improves nutritional quality.
Corporate partnerships make it possible to grow without losing operational control.

list.title: Family Food Basket
list.desc: Monthly delivery of basic food baskets to families in food poverty. Each basket includes grains, legumes, oil, and basic products.

list.title: Fresh Food Rescue
list.desc: We partner with supermarkets and restaurants to rescue fruits, vegetables, and near-expiry food, distributing them the same day.

list.title: Corporate Donations
list.desc: Partnership program with companies that donate products, services, or financial resources to expand our distribution capacity.

list.title: Community Bank
list.desc: We set up donation reception points in neighborhoods, where residents can donate food to be redistributed within the same community.

seo.title: Orquestas del Rey
seo.description: Orquestas del Rey — music training program by Armonizando Vidas A.B.P. We transform lives through art, music, and excellence.

hero.title: The art that
hero.subtitle: We train musicians of excellence from childhood, using the orchestra as a tool for social transformation, human development, and hope.

storyBand.title: The orchestra teaches much more than
storyBand.description: Every rehearsal develops discipline, listening, memory, collaboration, and confidence. Music becomes a safe space where children and youth learn to imagine a different future.
storyBand.imageAlt: Youth orchestra rehearsing with string instruments
items: Classes combine individual technique, group practice, and stage preparation.
Concerts strengthen self-esteem and show the community local talent.
Each instrument opens a door to habits of excellence and belonging.

items.title: Musical Training
items.desc: Individual and group classes with certified teachers who guide each student in their instrument.

items.title: Teamwork
items.desc: The orchestra as a metaphor for life: cooperation, listening, and mutual respect in every rehearsal.

items.title: Artistic Excellence
items.desc: We prepare musicians for professional performances that generate pride and self-esteem.

items.title: Community Impact
items.desc: Free concerts for the community that democratize access to high-quality music.

cta.title: Music is not just art,
cta.subtitle: Support the young musicians of Orquestas del Rey with your donation or join as a volunteer.

seo.description: Upcoming concerts and events from Orquestas del Rey, Armonizando Vidas A.B.P.

storyBand.title: Every concert is a
storyBand.description: Events are the point where classroom effort meets community. Families, teachers, volunteers, and students celebrate together a process that takes months of practice.
items: Free concerts bring music to people who normally don't have access.
Masterclasses connect students with professional musicians and experiences.
Each performance helps build stage confidence, discipline, and team spirit.

events.title: Season Closing Concert
events.desc: The most important concert of the year, season closing with the presentation of new talent.
